audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Zero-pairing harmonic wedge cannot be written as pairing times volume plus exact form; Standard PL representatives do not prove sufficiency for every given smooth structure of a homeomorphism type; Nonuniqueness example uses overlapping initial balls and a zoom that includes a transition annulus
limitations: Counterevidence: Theorem4.4 explicitly uses a nonzero pairing and is unaffected. Correct decomposition h(c1) wedge h(c2)=I/vol(N) vol_N+d eta proves the proposition using the existing weak-wedge/exact-form lemmas.

Counterevidence: Necessary beta2+/-<=3 bound and existence of standard QR representatives are valid. Weaker homeomorphism-type classification follows. No nonelliptic exotic example and no assertion of existence of any particular exotic structure in small range.
Counterevidence: Use r_j/4 for pureQ zoom and negative center -j^2 e1,scalej for pureidentity. Uniform radial-twist derivative/inverse bounds prove globalquasiconformality. Nonuniqueness survives.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
